firstPlayerRule: The player who most recently traveled by plane starts. Continue clockwise.
houseFallback: If this criterion does not suit your group, agree to choose randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: Flip the sand timer to begin. Although the game runs in real time, players take turns one at a time.
